settings.description: Afterhours Radio is a listening room for the city at night. Follow the shifts from street-level tape to bass records and the long hush before dawn.

settings.title: Running order
settings.description: Three one-hour programmes, from the street to the quiet end of the dial.

settings.title: The programmes
settings.description: Open each programme to find its presenter, sound and starting time.

tabs.title: Street Level
tabs.subtitle: 22:00 · Mina Vale
tabs.content: Shutter motors, rehearsals through a party wall, a tram taking a corner too quickly. Mina pairs street recordings with records from the neighbourhoods they came from.

tabs.title: Low End Theory
tabs.subtitle: 23:00 · Jules Okoro
tabs.content_title: A little more room for the bass.
tabs.content: Jules follows a single bass line across a shelf of records, from dub versions and broken beat to newly pressed club tracks. The sequence moves slowly enough to hear the links.

tabs.title: Last Light
tabs.subtitle: 00:00 · Nell Park
tabs.content_title: Leave a little silence at the end.
tabs.content: Nell picks long pieces for short winter nights. Expect tape loops, distant keys and records that need the full side to tell their story.

settings.title: In the booth
settings.description: Before the first record goes on, Mina Vale takes the station microphone outside.

items.title: Street Level / listen for the room
items.description: When a voice ends, listen for the pavement, air vents and distant footsteps still in the recording.

items.title: Low End Theory / follow one line
items.description: Pick out the bass and see what changes around it as a dub version gives way to a new rhythm.

items.title: Last Light / let the side finish
items.description: Give the quiet part a minute. Nell leaves the tail of each record intact.

settings.name: Mina Vale
settings.bio: Mina starts every Street Level set with the noise of one place. She takes a pocket recorder on the last tram, leaves a little room tone in every interview, and keeps a notebook of the records she plays.

settings.title: Pick a programme for the night.
settings.description: Three one-hour programmes every Friday and Saturday, from 22:00 to 01:00 local time.
